True transparent upper sky and gaps; no sky fill, sun, moon, clouds, stars, dogs, beds, text/UI or particles. Landscape 3:2 1536x1024. Specific changes: SPRING DAY: replace each plain pink blossom circle in the tree with a carefully drawn small cluster of 3–5 five-petalled cherry blossoms. Give some blossoms a side view and some a small closed bud. Arrange in small asymmetrical clusters attached to the existing branch tips with small pointed mint leaves. At ground level, replace plain pink shrub discs with geometric flowering shrubs bearing a few clear five-petal pink/cream blossoms and one or two small daffodil groups with 6 pointed petals, orange trumpet centers, long blade leaves. Keep details readable at 600px wide and leave breathing room. Do not cover the ground everywhere.
